pathways.biological_meaning: TVMCD · 15 PATHWAYS.  ⚠ D14 (microbiome) and D15 (25-OH-D) are declared GLOBAL_MODIFIER_PENDING — they have NO organ consumer in sheets 139/159 and none may be invented. Fail closed: the absence is machine-visible and must be resolved by a versioned, cited weight mapping before either pathway can influence an organ score. Do not silently drop them.  [v39p SOL-D14]
pathways.inputs: glucose exposure, added sugar, glycemic load, HbA1c/CGM if available
pathways.parameters: k_age [1/day], Vmax [AU/day], Km [AU], H gate; thresholds 140/180 mg/dL
pathways.integration_cadence: nightly; immediate when validated anchor arrives
pathways.numerical_method: exact ZOH for first-order forcing; RK4/full ODE optional for stiff sidecars
pathways.bounds: Z>=ε in log form; output clipped to safe finite range
pathways.initialization: from O·O11 warm-start or zero with prior covariance for D01
pathways.uncertainty_treatment: E posterior samples propagated; model discrepancy stored in U-Ledger
pathways.validation_scenario: D01: high/low synthetic scenario; anchor replays through E/F/H
